summary: Hillsbrad is the best-preserved corner of old Lordaeron, pine and pasture and working farmland that the plague largely missed, and it belongs to the Forsaken now. Tarren Mill is the largest town, the Sludge Fields beside it are an experiment carried out in the open, and Southshore was rendered uninhabitable with the New Plague before the Alliance came back to start clearing it. The Alterac Mountains along the north hold Crushridge ogres in the ruined capital, the crater where Dalaran used to stand, and the Stormpike dwarves who keep trying to come down out of them.
history: For pleasant farming country this has been fought over more often than anywhere else on Azeroth. Stormwind's refugees landed near Southshore after the First War and settled there. The Alliance of Lordaeron then mustered its whole strength in these foothills and the Horde came ashore unopposed anyway, dragonfire having scattered the fleet sent to stop it; the battle that followed was the first great land engagement of the Second War, where Gul'dan's death knights were used for the first time and the new paladins burned their fog off the field. Doomhammer broke into Durnholde himself to free Zul'jin from the cells. Thrall's orcs later took Southshore's ships to reach Kalimdor. The Forsaken finished what the wars started: Tarren Mill, the Sludge Fields, and Southshore poisoned outright.
